subject_definitions:
<Video 1> is the source video for the target video edit: a continuous 10-second portrait shot in which a black-and-white cat flies forward along a straight line through a golden autumn forest, comes closest to the lens at the centre of the frame and keeps flying forward, shrinking as it recedes until it disappears into a swirling tunnel of golden leaves.
<Subject 1> is the man shown in <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>: a Chinese Ming-dynasty official with a black gauze winged hat with a gold crescent ornament, a short beard and thin moustache, a long blue round-collar robe with a large embroidered rank badge on the chest and a matching decorated hem band, a black belt and black boots. His face is severe, composed and commanding.
<Picture 1> is a standing character sheet that contains a front facial close-up, a front full-body view and a back full-body view of the same man; it is the authority for his costume only: the black gauze winged hat, the blue round-collar robe, the embroidered chest badge, the decorated hem band, the black belt and the black boots.
<Picture 2> is a single front-facing portrait of the same man from the chest up on a plain white background; it is the sole authority for his facial identity: the same face shape, eyes, brows, nose, thin moustache, chin beard, hairline and skin tone.
<Picture 1> and <Picture 2> depict the same man, and the target video contains exactly one man from the first frame to the last frame, with no second person and no duplicated figure.
<Audio 1> is the synchronized audio track of <Video 1>, reused unchanged as the target video's complete final soundtrack.

<Video 1> (single continuous shot): fully_preserved - one uncut shot; the subject flies forward in a single direction with no turn-around and no reversal, and a locked-off tripod camera only pans horizontally to follow him, plus the golden autumn forest, backlit sunlight, radial blur, leaf tunnel and every motion beat, are copied 1:1.
<Audio 1>: fully_copy - <Audio 1> is reused 1:1 as the target video's complete final audio track.

detailed_description:
The target video is a live-action cinematic single take with the same portrait aspect ratio, golden autumn color palette and warm backlit lighting as <Video 1>.
[Shot 1] The shot opens deep inside a tunnel of swirling golden leaves, where <Subject 1>, the Ming-dynasty official whose face and beard match <Picture 2> and whose black gauze winged hat, blue round-collar robe with an embroidered chest badge, black belt and black boots match <Picture 1>, appears small and distant on the left side of the frame. He is airborne and flying forward in a classic superhero flight pose: his left arm is fully extended in front of him with the fist closed and the knuckles facing forward, his right arm is bent and swept back along his right side with the hand trailing behind his hip, his legs are pressed together and held straight behind him with the knees locked and both toes pointed back, so his body reads as one straight line from the forward fist to the toes. He never turns around, never reverses and never changes direction: he holds one straight flight line from the beginning of the shot to the end. The robe behaves like heavy silk: it stays close to his body and keeps its shape, only the lower hem and the cuff edges sway slightly backward, and the surface shows natural folds and creases. The hat is a solid black gauze cap with two stiff horizontal wings, and nothing hangs or trails from the hat or its wings. The belt is a plain black band. Each sleeve is a closed tube of blue cloth, and the robe is one continuous blue panel from the collar to the hem, with the embroidered chest badge and the decorated hem band lying flat on the cloth. His face points along his flight direction but his eyes stay fixed on the open air ahead of him, and he is not yet looking at the camera.
The camera sits on a fixed tripod beside his flight line, at the same height as his body, looking level, and it never travels through space: no push-in, no pull-back, no lateral dolly, no crane move and no zoom. It only pans horizontally on its head, turning to follow him with a slight human lag, so he is not locked dead centre but is allowed to drift within about ten percent of the frame before the pan catches up. His forward speed stays constant and his distance from the camera shortens and then lengthens along the same straight line, so he grows steadily larger on screen, reaches his largest size at the centre of the frame and then shrinks again as he passes the closest point and recedes.
At about 00:03.600, still flying forward at unchanged speed along the same line, he turns his head toward the lens and lifts his eyes to meet the viewer's eyes directly, as though he has just noticed that someone is watching him. The corners of his mouth rise very slightly into a quiet, knowing smile that does not show his teeth. From this moment his gaze is aimed straight into the lens, and the image reads as a man looking directly out of the frame at the person watching him: a deliberate fourth-wall break.
From about 00:03.800 to 00:05.300 he holds that look and that faint smile for about one and a half seconds while his body keeps flying forward on the same line, his head turned toward the lens and his shoulders and chest staying square to the camera. The only movements during the hold are one slow blink around 00:04.500, a single shallow breath that lifts his chest inside the robe, and a very slight lift of the chin. His eyes never drift, never dart and never leave the lens, his head does not jerk or snap, and he does not slow down, stop or change height.
At about 00:05.400 the smile fades, his gaze slides away from the lens back to the air ahead of him, his head returns to the flight direction, and he simply keeps flying forward along the same straight line. The pan continues to follow him, and because he is now moving away from the closest point his figure on screen begins to shrink.
From about 00:06.000 to 00:08.000 he recedes rapidly along the same line as the golden leaf tunnel tightens and rotates around him, his robe stays close to his body with only the hem swaying, until he becomes a small blue figure deep inside the tunnel, with the pan still following him.
From about 00:08.000 to the final frame the man is completely gone and the camera holds its last pan angle on the spinning tunnel of golden leaves and warm light. The background trees, the leaf-covered ground, the low sun and the color temperature remain identical throughout, and no new objects, extra performers, captions or on-screen text appear.

overall_soundscape:
The target video carries no environmental ambience: there is no wind, no rustling leaves, no birdsong, no footsteps and no rush of air while the subject flies.

non_diegetic_music:
<Audio 1> is reused unchanged from the first frame to the last frame as the complete audience-only score.
